title: Modeling procedural justice in public engagements with pipeline infrastructure: a coupled infrastructure systems approach to examining participatory environmental governance
abstract: This paper proposes a modeling approach to examining procedural justice in public engagements with oil and gas pipelines in the United States. We draw on the Robust Coupled Infrastructure Systems (CIS) framework to illustrate how power and influence is contested amongst public, industry, and regulatory stakeholders through their interactions within social, ecological, and technical systems. Our model is based on extensive document reviews of federal regulations, industry standards, and civil society organization guidance. Two speculative design workshops involving representatives from ten advocacy organizations working on pipeline issues form the basis of our demonstrating the model’s usefulness as a diagnostic tool. Using workshop findings as inputs, we identify important feedback loops related to communication, information access transparency, and capacity building issues, and show how weak feedback loops form the basis of power asymmetries. We bring particular attention to the technical workflows of advocacy work, conceptualized as civic technoscience and data justice. We then use the model to anticipate potential system-level changes brought on by new industry standards introduced by the American Petroleum Institute’s RP 1185 for Enhanced Public Engagement. We highlight where the RP may repair or leave unchanged feedback loops found to be critical to procedural justice. Using these case studies, we argue that the CIS framework makes visible the infrastructural conditions that enable and constrain how communities can meaningfully shape pipeline infrastructure projects. We conclude by suggesting that CIS-based modeling broadly offers opportunities to unpack the complexities of environmental governance and allow for a framework that can be applied to other types of relevant energy infrastructure such as transmission lines, CO2 pipelines, and others.
abstract_zh: 本文提出一种建模方法，用以考察美国公众参与油气管道事务中的程序正义问题。我们借鉴稳健耦合基础设施系统（CIS）框架，阐明公众、产业和监管利益相关方如何通过其在社会、生态和技术系统中的互动，争夺权力与影响力。我们的模型建立在对联邦法规、行业标准和民间组织指导文件的大量文献回顾之上。两场推测性设计研讨会的参与者来自十个致力于管道问题的倡导组织，这些研讨会构成了我们展示该模型作为诊断工具之实用性的基础。以研讨会的发现作为输入，我们识别出与沟通、信息获取透明度和能力建设相关的重要反馈回路，并说明薄弱的反馈回路如何形成权力不对称的基础。我们特别关注倡导工作的技术流程，将其概念化为公民技术科学与数据正义。随后，我们利用该模型预判美国石油学会新推出的RP 1185《强化公众参与》行业标准可能带来的系统层面变化。我们指出，该推荐做法在哪些方面可能修复或保留对程序正义至关重要的反馈回路。通过这些案例研究，我们认为CIS框架能够揭示基础设施条件，正是这些条件决定了社区能否有意义地影响管道基础设施项目。最后，我们指出，基于CIS的建模广泛地为解析环境治理的复杂性提供了机会，并可形成一个适用于输电线路、二氧化碳管道等其他类型相关能源基础设施的框架。

title: The Social Lifecycle Impacts of Power Plant Siting in the Historical United States
venue: Environmental and Energy Policy and the Economy
abstract: This paper examines the relative contributions of siting decisions and post-siting demo-graphic shifts to current disparities in exposure to polluting fossil-fuel plants in the United States. Our analysis leverages newly digitized data on power plant siting and operations from 1900-2020, combined with spatially resolved demographics and population data from the U.S Census from 1870-2020.We find little evidence that fossil-fuel plants were disproportionately sited in counties with higher Black population shares on average. However, event study estimates indicate that Black population share grows in the decades after the first fossil-fuel plant is built in a county, with average increases in Black population share of 4 percentage points in the 50-70 years after first siting. These long-run demographic shifts are driven by counties that first hosted a fossil-fuel plant between 1900-1949.We close by exploring how these long-run demographic shifts were shaped by the Great Migration, differential sorting in response to pollution, and other factors. Our findings highlight that the equity implications of siting long-lived infrastructure can differ dramatically depending on the time span considered.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了选址决策与选址后的人口结构变化，各自对当前美国民众接触化石燃料污染电厂之程度的差异所作的相对贡献。我们的分析利用了新数字化的1900至2020年电厂选址与运营数据，并结合了1870至2020年美国人口普查中具有空间分辨率的人口统计与人口数据。我们发现，平均而言，几乎没有证据表明化石燃料电厂被不成比例地建在黑人人口比例较高的县。然而，事件研究估计结果表明，在一个县首座化石燃料电厂建成后的数十年间，黑人人口比例会上升，在选址后50至70年间，平均增加4个百分点。这些长期的人口结构变化主要由1900至1949年间首次建有化石燃料电厂的县所驱动。最后，我们探讨了这些长期人口变化如何受到大迁徙（Great Migration）、对污染的差异化分选以及其他因素的影响。我们的研究结果表明，长寿命基础设施选址的公平性影响，可能会因所考虑的时间跨度不同而产生巨大差异。

title: Is the environmental exposure gap for overburdened communities shrinking? Evidence from an extreme multi-exposure index
Dust in the Wind: The Health Costs of Great Salt Lake Desiccation

Spatial Patterns of Access to Public EV Charging in Maricopa County, Arizona
The Effects of Environmental Distress on Labor Markets: Evidence from Brazil
abstract: This article documents how environmental distress affects individual-level labor market outcomes in Latin America’s largest economy. We collect data on a broad range of environmental distress events namely heat waves, floods, fires, and droughts, and combine these with uniquely rich administrative information covering the universe of formal employment in Brazil from 2003 to 2017. We find heterogeneous labor effects in response to environmental distress. We find that heat waves disrupt employment, increasing retirement rates by over 30 percent within the year of occurrence and beyond, driven by relatively more educated workers. Studying cross-municipality migration as a potential adaptation mechanism, we find little evidence that environmental distress increases the likelihood of individual out-migration. To the contrary, when floods or heat waves occur at typical destinations, the likelihood of migration among potential migrants and potential return migrants decreases significantly. Additionally, heat waves and floods reduce the likelihood cross-state out-migration, highlighting how environmental distress acts as a deterrent to migration. Our work contributes to understanding how environmental distress affects even the relatively more educated and higher-income formal labor force.
abstract_zh: 本文考察环境困境如何影响拉丁美洲最大经济体中个体层面的劳动力市场结果。我们收集了热浪、洪水、火灾和干旱等广泛的环境困境事件数据，并将其与涵盖2003至2017年巴西全部正规就业人口的独特丰富行政数据相结合。我们发现，环境困境对劳动力的影响具有异质性。我们发现，热浪扰乱了就业，在事件发生当年及之后，退休率上升超过30%，且这一效应主要由受教育程度相对较高的工人驱动。在考察跨市迁移这一潜在适应机制时，我们发现几乎没有证据表明环境困境会提高个体迁出的可能性。相反，当洪水或热浪发生在典型的目的地时，潜在迁移者和潜在返乡迁移者的迁移可能性显著下降。此外，热浪和洪水降低了跨州迁出的可能性，这凸显了环境困境如何对迁移起到威慑作用。本研究有助于理解环境困境如何影响即便是受教育程度相对较高、收入较高的正规劳动力。

title: The Environmental Costs and Geography of U.S. Data Center Expansion
Affordable solar for whom? Understanding the effects of a policy intervention on residential solar adoption among vulnerable communities
Community-Engaged Economics Research for the Clean Energy Transition
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: There has been a growing effort to design environmental and energy policies that emphasize equity for historically underserved communities. Recently, the Inflation Reduction Act of 2022 allocated substantial resources to propel the clean energy transition, specifically emphasizing environmental justice and equity for low-income households. Although these policies hold promise for significant emissions reductions, the imperative of equitable outcomes necessitates active community involvement. Environmental economists are uniquely positioned to evaluate the energy transition policies’ impact on environmental justice; however, the focus on efficiency in conventional economic policy analysis may not sufficiently address the intricacies of this endeavor. This article examines the role of community-engaged research (CEnR) in environmental economics, evaluating its adoption within the field and highlighting its potential for enhancing research methodologies in the context of the clean energy transition. CEnR represents an evolution in research practices, encompassing ethical considerations and placing community perspectives at the center of academic analyses. More broadly, it underscores the importance of integrating community insights into economic research, to ensure that our research is grounded in real-world conditions and that our clean energy policy recommendations reflect the needs, concerns, and interests of the participating communities.
abstract_zh: 近来，设计强调历史上服务不足社区公平性的环境与能源政策的努力日益增多。2022年《通胀削减法案》拨付了大量资源以推动清洁能源转型，特别强调环境正义以及低收入家庭的公平性。尽管这些政策有望大幅减少排放，但公平的结果要求社区积极参与其中。环境经济学家在评估能源转型政策对环境正义的影响方面具有独特优势；然而，传统经济政策分析中对效率的关注，可能不足以应对这一工作的复杂性。本文考察了社区参与型研究（CEnR）在环境经济学中的作用，评估其在该领域的采用情况，并强调其在清洁能源转型背景下提升研究方法的潜力。CEnR代表了研究实践的一种演进，它涵盖伦理考量，并将社区视角置于学术分析的中心。更广泛地看，它强调将社区的见解纳入经济研究的重要性，以确保我们的研究立足于现实条件，并使我们的清洁能源政策建议反映参与社区的需求、关切和利益。

title: The Effects of Renewable Energy Projects on Employment: Evidence from Brazil
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: This paper studies the employment impacts of renewable energy projects in Brazil. Between 2006 and 2017, Brazil's solar capacity grew from 0.001 GW to 1.01 GW, and wind capacity grew from 0.23 GW to 12.4 GW. Using detailed employment information from the universe of formal workers in Brazil, we analyze how the development of renewable energy projects impacts local economies. We find that when new wind energy projects come online, the number of firms in a municipality increases by 14.84 percent and total employment in a municipality increases by 15.95 percent. Employment in occupations related to electricity, construction, and transportation increase by even more. The employment increases appear to stem from growth of existing firms and increased entry of new firms. The findings are mirrored in municipal sales tax revenue and income tax revenue. Our results are not explained by electricity grid expansions or construction of federal roads. Notably, we find larger effects in areas with high shares of informality.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了可再生能源项目对巴西就业的影响。2006至2017年间，巴西的太阳能装机容量从0.001吉瓦增长至1.01吉瓦，风电装机容量从0.23吉瓦增长至12.4吉瓦。利用巴西全部正规工人的详细就业信息，我们分析了可再生能源项目的发展如何影响当地经济。我们发现，当新的风电项目投运时，一个市的企业数量增加14.84%，该市的总就业增加15.95%。与电力、建筑和交通运输相关职业的就业增长幅度更大。就业增长似乎源于现有企业的扩张以及新企业的更多进入。这一结果在市级销售税和所得税收入中得到了印证。我们的结果无法由电网扩张或联邦公路建设来解释。值得注意的是，在非正规就业占比较高的地区，影响更大。

title: Recent findings and methodologies in economics research in environmental justice
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: This review synthesizes economics-oriented research in environmental justice with a focus on the last decade. We first categorize this literature into broad areas of inquiry and review main findings. Then, we review recent advances in data and methodologies that have allowed for new study designs and research questions. After identifying breakthroughs, we offer some guidance on how to continue to advance research in this area.
abstract_zh: 本综述以过去十年为重点，对以经济学为导向的环境正义研究进行了梳理。我们首先将这一文献归入若干大的研究领域，并回顾其主要发现。随后，我们回顾了数据和方法方面的最新进展，这些进展使新的研究设计与研究问题成为可能。在确认这些突破之后，我们就如何继续推进该领域研究提出了一些指导性意见。

title: Water, dust, and environmental justice: The case of agricultural water diversions
abstract: Water diversions for agriculture reduce ecosystem services provided by saline lakes around the world. Exposed lakebed surfaces are major sources of dust emissions that may exacerbate existing environmental inequities. This paper studies the effects of water diversions and their impacts on particulate pollution arising from reduced inflows to the Salton Sea in California via a spatially explicit particle transport model and changing lakebed exposure. We demonstrate that lakebed dust emissions increased ambient and concentrations and worsened environmental inequalities, with historically disadvantaged communities receiving a disproportionate increase in pollution. Water diversion decisions are often determined by political processes; our findings demonstrate the need for distributional analysis of such decisions to ensure equitable compensation.
abstract_zh: 农业引水减少了世界各地咸水湖所提供的生态系统服务。裸露的湖床表面是尘埃排放的主要来源，可能加剧现有的环境不平等。本文利用空间显式的颗粒物输运模型以及湖床暴露的变化，研究了加利福尼亚州Salton Sea因入湖水量减少而引发的引水效应，以及由此产生的颗粒物污染影响。我们证明，湖床扬尘增加了环境空气中的颗粒物浓度，并加剧了环境不平等，历史上处于不利地位的社区承受了不成比例的污染增幅。引水决策往往由政治过程决定；我们的研究结果表明，有必要对此类决策进行分配性分析，以确保公平的补偿。

title: Do Environmental Markets Cause Environmental Injustice? Evidence from California's Carbon Market
abstract: Market-based environmental policies are widely adopted on the basis of allocative efficiency. However, there is growing concern that market-induced spatial reallocation of pollution could widen existing pollution concentration gaps between disadvantaged and other communities. We examine how this “environmental justice” (EJ) gap changed following the 2013 introduction of California’s carbon market, the world’s second largest and the most subjected to EJ critiques. We estimate that the program lowered GHG, PM2.5, PM10, and NOx emissions by 3–9% annually between 2012–2017 for sample industrial facilities regulated only by the carbon market. Using a pollution dispersal model to characterize resulting spatial changes in pollution concentrations, we find the program caused EJ gaps in PM2.5, PM10, and NOx from these facilities to narrow by 6–10% annually. We demonstrate that explicit modeling of pollution dispersal is critical for detecting these results.
abstract_zh: 基于配置效率，以市场为基础的环境政策得到了广泛采纳。然而，人们日益担忧，市场引致的污染空间再配置可能会扩大弱势社区与其他社区之间既有的污染浓度差距。我们考察了2013年加州碳市场（全球第二大碳市场，也是受环境正义批评最多的碳市场）推出后，这一“环境正义”（EJ）差距的变化情况。我们估计，在2012至2017年间，该计划使仅受碳市场监管的样本工业设施的温室气体、PM2.5、PM10和氮氧化物排放每年降低3%–9%。利用污染扩散模型来刻画由此产生的污染浓度空间变化，我们发现，该计划使这些设施产生的PM2.5、PM10和氮氧化物的环境正义差距每年缩小6%–10%。我们证明，对污染扩散进行显式建模，对于检测这些结果至关重要。

title: Do health disparities narrow with pollution disparities? Evidence from California
Effectiveness of travel behavior and infrastructure change to mitigate heat exposure
abstract: Urban heat exposure is an increasing health risk among urban dwellers. Many cities are considering accommodating active mobility, especially walking and biking, to reduce greenhouse gas emissions. However, promoting active mobility without proper planning and transportation infrastructure to combat extreme heat exposure may cause more heat-related morbidity and mortality, particularly in future with projected climate change. This study estimated the effectiveness of active trip heat exposure mitigation under built environment and travel behavior change. Simulations of the Phoenix metro region's 624,987 active trips were conducted using the activity-based travel model (ABM), mean radiant temperature (TMRT, net human radiation exposure), transportation network, and local climate zones. Two scenarios were designed to reduce traveler exposure: one that focuses on built environment change (making neighborhoods cooler) and the other on travel behavior (switching from shorter travel time but higher exposure routes to longer travel time but cooler routes) change. Travelers experienced TMRT heat exposure ranging from 29°C to 76°C (84°F to 168°F) without environmental or behavioral change. Active trip TMRT exposures were reduced by an average of 1.2–3.7°C when the built environment was changed from a hotter to cooler design. Behavioral changes cooled up to 10 times more trips than changes in built environment changes. The marginal benefit of cooling decreased as the number of cooled corridors transformed increased. When the most traveled 10 km of corridors were cooled, the marginal benefit affected over 1,000 trips/km. However, cooling all corridors results in marginal benefits as low as 1 trip/km. The results reveal that heavily traveled corridors should be prioritized with limited resources, and the best cooling results come from environment and travel behavior change together. The results show how to surgically invest in travel behavior and built environment change to most effectively protect active travelers.
abstract_zh: 城市热暴露是城市居民日益严重的健康风险。许多城市正考虑通过支持步行和骑行等主动出行方式来减少温室气体排放。然而，若缺乏适当的规划和应对极端高温的交通基础设施，促进主动出行可能导致更多与热相关的发病和死亡，尤其是在气候变化预计将进一步加剧的未来。本研究估算了在建成环境与出行行为改变下，主动出行热暴露缓解的效果。我们利用基于活动的出行模型（ABM）、平均辐射温度（TMRT，即人体净辐射暴露）、交通网络和地方气候分区，对凤凰城大都市区624,987次主动出行进行了模拟。我们设计了两种情景以降低出行者的暴露：一种侧重于建成环境改变（使社区更凉爽），另一种侧重于出行行为改变（从出行时间较短但暴露较高的路线转向出行时间较长但较凉爽的路线）。在没有环境或行为改变的情况下，出行者的TMRT热暴露范围为29°C至76°C（84°F至168°F）。当建成环境从较热的设计改为较凉爽的设计时，主动出行的TMRT暴露平均降低1.2–3.7°C。行为改变使降温的出行次数比建成环境改变多出多达10倍。随着被改造的降温走廊数量增加，降温的边际效益递减。当对出行最频繁的10公里走廊进行降温时，边际效益覆盖了超过每公里1,000次出行。然而，对所有走廊降温时，边际效益低至每公里1次出行。结果表明，应以有限的资源优先改造出行频繁的走廊，而环境与出行行为的共同改变可取得最佳的降温效果。研究结果说明了如何精准地投资于出行行为与建成环境的改变，以最有效地保护主动出行者。

title: Equitable low-carbon transition pathways for California's oil extraction
Changes in Weight-Related Outcomes Among Adolescents Following Consumer Price Increases of Taxed Sugar-Sweetened Beverages
Decomposing Trends in Air Pollution Disparities from U.S. Electricity
venue: Environmental and Energy Policy and the Economy
abstract: This paper quantifies and decomposes recent trends in US particulate matter (PM2.5) disparities from the electricity sector using a high-resolution pollution transport model. Between 2000 and 2018, PM2.5 concentrations from electricity fell by 89% for the average individual, more than double the decline rate in overall US ambient PM2.5 concentrations. Across racial/ethnic groups, we detect a dramatic convergence: since 2000, the Black-white PM2.5 disparity from electricity has narrowed by 95% and the Hispanic-white PM2.5 disparity has narrowed by 93%, though these disparities still exist in 2018. A decomposition reveals nearly all of these disparity trends can be attributed roughly equally to improvements in emissions intensities and compositional changes in electric generators, with small contributions from scale and residential location changes. This suggests both local air pollution policies and recent coal-to-natural gas fuel switching have played major roles in reducing US racial/ethnic pollution disparities from electricity. Although we detect similarly large PM2.5 improvements for the average low- and high-income individual, PM2.5 disparities by income are relatively small, with little change over time.
abstract_zh: 本文利用高分辨率污染输运模型，量化并分解了电力部门导致的美国颗粒物（PM2.5）差距的近期变化趋势。2000至2018年间，电力部门产生的PM2.5浓度对普通个体而言下降了89%，超过美国整体环境PM2.5浓度降幅的两倍。在不同种族/族裔群体之间，我们发现了显著的趋同：自2000年以来，电力部门导致的黑人与白人之间的PM2.5差距缩小了95%，西班牙裔与白人之间的差距缩小了93%，不过这些差距在2018年仍然存在。分解结果显示，几乎所有差距变化趋势都可大致同等地归因于排放强度的改善和发电机组构成的变化，规模和居住地点变化的贡献较小。这表明，地方空气污染政策和近期的煤改天然气燃料转换在减少美国电力导致的种族/族裔污染差距方面均发挥了重要作用。尽管我们也发现低收入和高收入个体的PM2.5均有大幅改善，但按收入划分的PM2.5差距相对较小，且随时间变化不大。

title: The Environmental Justice Dimension of the Mexican Emissions Trading System
venue: Towards an Emissions Trading System in Mexico
abstract:
Emissions trading systems have the potential of increasing air quality given that GHG emissions are often co-produced with local pollutants such as NOx, SOx, and Particulate Matter (PM). Can emissions trading systems exacerbate or alleviate environmental justice concerns in emerging economies? According to the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, Environmental Justice is achieved when no group is disproportionately affected by an environmental policy or phenomenon. The main objective of this chapter is to estimate the pollution burden faced by marginalized neighbourhoods in Mexico. This is relevant for Mexico given the beginning of the pilot program of the Mexican Emissions Trading System (ETS) and the country’s history of income inequality and poverty. Using linear regression and two-way fixed effects methods, we found that the highest emitters regulated under the ETS are located near poor populations. We estimated a 5$$\%$$
%
CO2 emissions-reduction scenario corresponding to national targets and associated NO2 emissions to that scenario. We find that this scenario is consistent with a decrease in the exposure of NO2 pollution for the most marginalized neighbourhoods. This chapter also discusses other potential sources of environmental injustice that could result after the beginning of the ETS and the potential to address them.
abstract_zh: 排放交易体系有可能提高空气质量，因为温室气体排放往往与NOx、SOx和颗粒物（PM）等局地污染物共同产生。排放交易体系能否加剧或缓解新兴经济体的环境正义问题？根据美国环境保护署的界定，当没有任何群体因某项环境政策或现象而受到不成比例的影响时，即实现了环境正义。本章的主要目的是估算墨西哥边缘化社区所承受的污染负担。鉴于墨西哥排放交易体系（ETS）试点计划的启动，以及该国长期存在的收入不平等和贫困问题，这一研究对墨西哥具有现实意义。我们采用线性回归和双向固定效应方法，发现在该排放交易体系下受监管的最高排放者位于贫困人口附近。我们估算了一个与国家目标相对应的二氧化碳减排5%的情景，以及与该情景相关的二氧化氮排放。我们发现，该情景与最边缘化社区的二氧化氮污染暴露降低相一致。本章还讨论了排放交易体系启动后可能产生的其他环境不公来源，以及应对这些问题的可能途径。

title: Droughts and rural households' wellbeing: evidence from Mexico
Are Land Values Related to Ambient Air Pollution Levels? Hedonic Evidence from Mexico City
abstract: This article investigates whether residents of Mexico City value air quality. Our results suggest that air quality improvement in PM10 is equivalent to a marginal willingness to pay (MWTP) of US$440.31 per property for the period 2006–2013. The corresponding MWTP for PM2.5 is US$880.63, for O3 is US$623.78, and for SO2 is as much as US$2091.50. These estimates are considerably larger in magnitude compared to the few other studies in similar settings. As a percentage of annual household income, these represent 2.44 per cent for PM10, 4.88 per cent for PM2.5, 3.46 per cent for O3 and 11.59 per cent for SO2. Our estimates of land value–pollution elasticities for PM10 (−0.26 and − 0.58) are within range of hedonic estimates for total suspended particulate matter in US cities around the 1970s. The corresponding elasticities range from − 0.55 to − 0.84 for PM2.5, from − 0.06 to − 0.49 for O3 and from − 0.11 to − 0.34 for SO2.
abstract_zh: 本文考察墨西哥城居民是否重视空气质量。我们的结果表明，在2006至2013年期间，PM10的空气质量改善相当于每处房产的边际支付意愿（MWTP）为440.31美元。PM2.5对应的MWTP为880.63美元，O3为623.78美元，SO2则高达2091.50美元。这些估计值与类似情境下的其他少数研究相比明显更大。以占家庭年收入的百分比计，这些数值分别为：PM10为2.44%，PM2.5为4.88%，O3为3.46%，SO2为11.59%。我们对PM10的土地价值—污染弹性估计值（−0.26和−0.58）与20世纪70年代美国城市中总悬浮颗粒物的享乐估计值范围相符。PM2.5对应的弹性范围为−0.55至−0.84，O3为−0.06至−0.49，SO2为−0.11至−0.34。
